description: The true path of the miniature: the cup was last seen after the suspect had left, and he could not come back; the order of events clears him, and the keys leave one man.

moves.see: the cup was on its shelf when the lamp was lit
moves.why: Tam Reed saw the cup on its shelf as he lit the lamp.
So it was taken after the lamp was lit.
It cannot have gone before: it was still there.

moves.see: the cup was still there when the lamp was lit
moves.why: Whoever took it took it after the lamp was lit.

moves.see: by then Bell was in mid-river
moves.why: The ferry cast off before the lamp was lit, with Bell aboard: Hobb saw it kindled behind them.
And the only boat lay at the far bank all night.
Bell left before the cup was last seen, and had no way back.
The vestry was locked when the lamp was lit.

moves.see: whoever took the cup had a key
moves.why: And at nine the lock had not been forced: it was opened with a key.
There are two keys, and mine was in my pocket.
The other key is the sexton's.
